settings.bio: Met 13 years ago through mutual connections, Georgina and Bianca combined their creative expertise — Bianca's branding and social media skills with Georgina's ceramic work — to establish the SA Art Fair in Hout Bay and, subsequently, The Studio.

settings.name: Susan Orpen
settings.bio: A celebrated South African artist with over three decades of teaching experience. Trained with a BA in English and History of Art, Susan works across watercolour, acrylic, and mixed media — creating wildlife, landscapes, and portraits that feature in international private collections.

settings.name: Kerri Sassen
settings.bio: A self-taught South African artist working across a variety of mediums, recently focusing on larger abstract pieces. Kerri also works as an Occupational Therapist, integrating both careers to celebrate, process, and break through via art.
settings.tags: Abstract · Mixed Media · Occupational Art Therapy

settings.name: Zara-Leigh Farinha
settings.bio: Johannesburg-born and Hout Bay-based, Zara-Leigh works intuitively with abstract acrylic and oil paintings on large-format canvas. With over 10 years' experience as a fashion, decor, and makeup artist across South Africa, London, and New York, she brings a uniquely global creative sensibility.
settings.tags: Abstract Acrylic · Oil on Canvas · Large Format
